It also highlights the tradition of naming practices in Hindu culture, where names hold Deep spiritual and philosophical meanings that shape the identity and values of the individual.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jankiyaa is imbued with spiritual significance as it represents the constant presence of God's Grace in one's life. The name serves as a reminder to the individual to be humble, thankful and mindful of the blessings bestowed upon them by the divine. It encourages the individual to live a righteous and devotional life, seeking to align oneself with the will of God and striving to be a vessel of His Love and Blessings to the world.
